key_work.title: Frog Detective 3: Corruption at Cowboy County
key_work.brief_description:
The third and final game in the Frog Detective trilogy finds mystery in Cowboy County, where Frog Detective joins the ‘number-one detective’, Lobster Cop, to solve the case of some stolen hats.
Worm Club combines the series’ usual detective work with the sights and sounds of the Western, as players interview and help a new cast of absurd townsfolk and outlaws. Cowboy County is bigger than the earlier games’ settings, with “vast and rough” terrain to cross. What began as a gag became one of the game’s key features: a scooter system developed by Tom Bowker, turning movement itself into part of the joke.

start.material_description: Executable videogame files (.exe), associated data and asset files.
start.brief_description: Untitled Goose Game is developed by Australian developer House House. Players take on the role of an annoying goose, waddling around an old English Town to create mischief and chaos. By completing a to-do list, players gradually unlock access to more areas of the town. Untitled Goose Game received widespread acclaim since its launched in late September 2019, with critics praising its gameplay and humour. It was named the D.I.C.E. Game of the Year and received a BAFTA Games Award for Best Family and Social game in 2020. It is available for PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo Switch, PC and Mac.

end.title: The Simpsons
end.brief_description: Set in Springfield, the average American town, the show focuses on the antics and everyday adventures of the Simpson family; Homer, Marge, Bart, Lisa and Maggie, as well as a virtual cast of thousands. Since the beginning, the series has been a pop culture icon, attracting hundreds of celebrities to guest star. The show has also made name for itself in its fearless satirical take on politics, media and American life in general.

end.creator_credit: David Brown and Richard D. Zanuck
end.brief_description: Steven Spielberg created the summer blockbuster with this holiday horror that snapped up more tickets at the box office than the great white shark did swimmers in the waters of Amity Island. Featuring one of cinema’s greatest villains and scores, it changed the movie-going landscape forever.

links.description: John Williams composed the scores for both The Cowboys and Jaws, moving from western adventure to oceanic terror. In Jaws, musical repetition becomes suspense, with its famous two-note theme turning into an instantly recognisable warning of unseen danger.

end.title: Brazil
end.creator_credit: Terry Gilliam, James Acheson, Arnon Milchan, Patrick Cassavetti, Embassy International Pictures, Norman Garwood, Charles McKeown and Tom Stoppard
end.headline_credit: United Kingdom and United States of America, 1985
end.brief_description: Low-level bureaucrat Sam Lowry escapes the monotony of his day-to-day life through a recurring daydream of himself as a virtuous hero saving a beautiful damsel. Investigating a case that led to the wrongful arrest and eventual death of an innocent man instead of wanted terrorist Harry Tuttle, he meets the woman from his daydream, and in trying to help her gets caught in a web of mistaken identities, mindless bureaucracy and lies.

results.description: This Constellation follows cosy mysteries where investigation is playful, social and a little strange. In these works, detectives question odd suspects, navigate anxious communities and solve cases where charm, humour and character matter just as much as the truth itself.

key_work.brief_description: Another mystery is afoot in Frog Detective 2: The Case of the Invisible Wizard. As the ‘second-best detective’, players interview a new cast of low-poly characters and follow clues through gentle, comic conversation.
